applicable_when: The kernel is a small GEMM (7840x40x144) with hardcoded tile sizes BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32 and no autotuning. The 128 registers/thread caps occupancy at 25% theoretical and only 6.25% achieved. The dominant NCU rule is SharedMemoryConflicts (65.48% speedup) caused by the current tile layout creating 11.9-way bank conflicts in shared memory during dot product accumulation. The grid of 123 blocks leaves some of the 132 SMs idle (0.23 waves/SM). Since N=40 is small, BLOCK_N=64 wastes work and forces masking. Reducing BLOCK_N to 32 (matching N better) and BLOCK_M to 32 reduces register pressure, increases occupancy, and doubles the grid to 246+ blocks covering all SMs. Adding @triton.autotune explores num_warps and num_stages to find the best configuration for this Hopper GPU.
